claims.text: AT deficiency + family hx of VTE: antepartum antithrombotic prophylaxis;
claims.quote: For women with antithrombin deficiency who have a family history of VTE and for those who are homozygous for the factor V Leiden mutation or who have combined thrombophilias, regardless of family history of VTE, the ASH guideline panel suggests antepartum antithrombotic prophylaxis

claims.text: AT deficiency + family hx of VTE: postpartum antithrombotic prophylaxis (strong rec).
claims.quote: For women with a family history of VTE who have antithrombin deficiency, the ASH guideline panel recommends postpartum antithrombotic prophylaxis

For women who have no family history of VTE but have antithrombin deficiency or are homozygous for the prothrombin gene mutation, the ASH guideline panel suggests against using antepartum antithrombotic prophylaxis
